limits.resumeReason: Preserve two stopped runs: initial unavailable (one generation) and successful Vertex response followed by a document capability prompt-version mismatch (one generation, one loader call). Main reproduced the mismatch offline and aligned summary-report 0.1.4 / pack 0.1.33. One explicit continuation may now finish the three cases on the same fixture; total generation+embedding stays 12, daily 12/user and 20/global unchanged, no automatic retry.

messages.expect: Clarify the missing purpose without inventing age, date or executing unrelated actions.

messages.text: 係去香港健康院問加固，佢大約半歲。我想問點開始加固同要留意啲乜。請引用家庭健康服務資料，整理一份到診準備單，加上「帶健康手冊」及「問開始加固方法」這兩項。日期未定，唔好安排任務或通知。

messages.text: 只把剛才準備單清單的「帶健康手冊」改為「帶最新生長記錄」，其他項目同標題都唔改。
messages.expect: Find the same document from preceding conversation; persist the requested item revision after the existing explicit confirmation boundary if required. Preserve other content and identity.

acceptance: Use real ProductAgent handler, Runner, Vertex provider, PostgreSQL and current public knowledge. Reopen pool/services once, then read the same latest document/history with real scope checks. Stop on first failure; preserve encrypted fixture/results outside repository. Do not accept unexpected tasks, contacts, dates, health facts or sharing changes. Main reviews citations and useful clarification; automated structural checks cannot prove clinical quality.
